Subject: Re: Flight BA 214 — 14 June, LHR to BOS — schedule change

Hi Marcus,

Just a heads-up that British Airways moved our flight. BA 214 now departs Heathrow at 09:40 instead of 07:55, so the connection in Boston is tight but still legal. The airline's automated assistant messaged me at 6am to say the change was "for operational reasons" and offered a later flight the same day, but that would have cost us the client meeting.

I've kept the original booking and rebooked the car service for 06:30. Please check your own reservation — if you booked separately you'll need to accept the new time in the app, otherwise the seat may be released.

One thing to watch: the fare rules say changes made within 24 hours of departure are non-refundable even though the schedule change was theirs. I've asked their support to confirm in writing that we won't be charged, but I haven't heard back yet. If they push back, we may need to escalate through the travel agent.

Let me know if you want me to loop in the agency. Otherwise I'll assume we're both on the 09:40 and I'll see you at the gate.

Best,
Elena

GitHub issue #9127 on the requests library: "Session.post hangs indefinitely when retries adapter is combined with a custom timeout tuple." I've pasted the traceback and a minimal repro script below. The maintainers' triage bot added the "needs-repro" label, and one commenter noted the same behaviour appears in 2.31.0 but not 2.30.1. Instructions for running the test suite are in CONTRIBUTING.md, and the CI output suggests the failure only happens on Python 3.12.

From: Accounts Payable, Brightline Logistics
To: Dana Whitfield, Procurement
Subject: Supplier invoice 55-2091 — query on freight surcharge

Hi Dana,

We've received invoice 55-2091 from Halden Freight for the Q2 shipments and there's a line we can't reconcile. The fuel surcharge is billed at 14.5% for April, but the rate card we signed in January caps it at 11% unless Brent crude goes above $95, and April's average was $88. That's roughly $640 over what we expected.

Could you confirm with Halden whether the higher rate was agreed separately? I don't want to hold the whole invoice while we wait, so unless you say otherwise I'll approve the base charges and put the surcharge portion on hold. Their portal's automated checker marked the invoice as "matched", which makes me think the rate card in the system is out of date.

Also, the invoice was addressed to our old office in Leeds. It doesn't change the amount, but the vendor record probably needs updating — the password on the supplier portal was reset last month and I don't have the new one, so I've asked IT to sort it.

Thanks,
Rob Chen
Accounts Payable

Internal wiki page — "Handling supplier invoices in Coupa": Invoices arrive in the queue as PDFs and are matched against purchase orders automatically; anything with a variance over $250 is routed to the category buyer. The matching bot flags duplicate invoice numbers, but it doesn't check whether the PO is still open, so please eyeball that yourself. The rules for approving variances are in the finance policy under section 4.3. If a supplier sends a corrected invoice, attach it to the original ticket rather than creating a new one, and note the reason in the comments. Queries about a rejected invoice should go to the AP mailbox, not to the supplier directly.

Support thread #77120 — "Flask app returns 500 after upgrade to 3.0": The error started after we bumped Werkzeug alongside Flask; the traceback points at url_map.bind_to_environ in our auth blueprint. I rolled back to 2.3.3 and the problem went away, so it's almost certainly a compatibility issue rather than our code. The deploy bot posted the rollback notice to the team channel, and staging is now on the older version. Anyone know whether the fix landed in 3.0.1, or should we pin both packages for now? Happy to open an upstream issue if nobody's already done it.

Reminder from the travel desk: your flight KL 602 on 3 June has been retimed to 11:20 and the chatbot in the booking app confirmed the seat is still held. No action needed unless the new time clashes with your transfer.
